title: Settings
description: API key, downloads, proxy, cache, and deletion safety.

access.heading: Wallhaven Access
access.description: API key is masked by default and stored through the desktop settings layer.
access.emptyHint: Empty value clears the local key. Full key is never written to UI logs.

directory.heading: Download Directory
directory.description: Changing this path affects future downloads only. Existing Gallery records keep their archived file paths.

network.heading: Network Proxy
network.description: Leave address empty for direct Wallhaven API access.
network.validationHint: Proxy validation runs before future Search and Download requests use this setting.
network.fixProxyBeforeTesting: Fix proxy settings before testing connectivity.

advanced.heading: Advanced
advanced.description: Deletion prompts and the local cache estimate.
advanced.resetCacheDescription: No cache deletion command exists yet. This only resets the displayed cache estimate; downloaded wallpaper originals stay in place.
advanced.noOriginalsRemoved: No downloaded wallpaper originals were removed.

destination.heading: Effective Destination
destination.galleryCompatibilityValue: Existing SQLite records keep their saved relative and absolute file paths.
destination.cacheValue: {{value}} · meter reset never removes downloaded wallpaper originals.
destination.securityPreview: Desktop settings storage is unavailable in this web preview; API key persistence is disabled until the app runs inside Tauri.
destination.securityReady: API key is masked in UI and persisted through the Tauri Store settings file.

footer.ready: Settings affect future tasks immediately after save.

errors.directoryInvalid: Folder does not exist or is not writable
errors.proxyAddressInvalid: Proxy address must be host:port without a scheme

apiKey.fixProxyBeforeValidation: Fix proxy settings before validating the API key.
apiKey.clearedAfterSave: API key will be cleared after saving settings.
apiKey.validWithProxy: Wallhaven accepted the request with this API key through the configured proxy.
apiKey.validWithoutProxy: Wallhaven accepted the request with this API key.

toasts.settingsSavedDescription: Future searches, downloads, and local library reads now use this configuration.

storage.unavailableMessage: Settings failed to load, so storage summary is unavailable.
